unit.why: Homiletic teachings from several Hasidic masters on bearing the yoke of divine service and on coming prepared to the tsaddik. The only narrative is a one-sentence illustrative anecdote about the Maggid of Kozienice.
unit.boundary_note: teachings continue into next division (עוד שם ממורי ז"ל)

stories.start_quote: וכמי שאמרו על הרב המגיד הקדוש
stories.summary_en: Before travelling to the Maggid of Mezeritch, the Maggid of Kozienice studied eight hundred kabbalistic books, yet on arriving he realized he had not yet begun to learn anything.

tags.why: The anecdote is embedded in an extended homily on preparing oneself before coming to the tsaddik.
